# hub-modules

The one module list: every board once, with every route to it, and the fastest route chosen.

## Rules and traps

- One board is one row however it is reached: board_key is the chip MAC when the board reports one.
- `_route_table` is shared with main.py by reference: mutate it in place, never reassign it.
- QC swaps main.remote_modules, main.scan_modules, main.probe_usb_all: this file reads them as `_hub.`.
